guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：GAT 圖注意力網路
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: GAT graph attention network
guides.concept: 以鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習解析GAT 圖注意力網路：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore GAT graph attention network through neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識節點與邊張量。GAT在指定鄰域上正規化注意力；全連接attention與稀疏圖鄰域的可見資訊不同。 建立圖鄰域遮罩的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用三節點圖逐節點列出合法鄰居與權重正規化範圍。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識鄰域masked attention。注意力aij可與aji不同，即使基礎鄰接圖無向；聚合仍需保留目標節點與來源。 建立非對稱邊權與聚合的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想特徵手算兩方向權重並檢查節點更新。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識聚合與梯度路徑。跨未見圖泛化與同圖未標籤節點预测不同；圖建構本身也可能洩漏標籤。 建立歸納式與轉導式證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開兩種測試邊界並審查建邊資訊來源。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識節點邊數的成本。參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 建立運算量與記憶體的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識未見圖與資料隔離。訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 建立資料切分與洩漏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識度數偏差與解釋。平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 建立失效分析與泛化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify node and edge tensors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. GAT normalizes attention over designated neighborhoods; dense attention sees different information than a sparse graph. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of graph-neighborhood masks, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List allowed neighbors/normalization domains in a three-node graph. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify neighborhood masked attention in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. Attention aij may differ from aji even on undirected adjacency; aggregation retains target/source roles. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of asymmetric weights and aggregation, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate assumed bidirectional weights and check node updates. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify aggregation and gradients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. Unseen-graph generalization differs from unlabeled-node prediction on one graph; graph construction itself can leak labels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of inductive and transductive evidence, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate both test boundaries and audit edge-construction information. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify node/edge-count cost in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compute and memory, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify unseen-graph isolation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify degree bias and interpretation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交未見圖與資料隔離的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交度數偏差與解釋的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交度數偏差與解釋的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for unseen-graph isolation.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for degree bias and interpretation.

related.title: Transformer 注意力編解碼器
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習；Transformer 注意力編解碼器改以QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning; Transformer attention encoder-decoder centers on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照節點與邊張量與token與位置張量，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Transformer 注意力編解碼器，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以度數偏差與解釋為起點，設計一項能區分「鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習」與「QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare node and edge tensors with token and position tensors and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Transformer attention encoder-decoder, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from degree bias and interpretation and propose an observation distinguishing neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning from qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation, including uncertainty.
